# Meta tree

<div class="rr-stats"><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">41</span><span class="rr-stat-label">nodes in the base tree</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">72</span><span class="rr-stat-label">levels to buy</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">4,268</span><span class="rr-stat-label">meta for the whole tree</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">27</span><span class="rr-stat-label">ascension nodes</span></div></div>

Meta points buy permanent upgrades that help every run. Each node needs the node before it, starting from Awakening.

- The tree only shows nodes up to 3 steps from what you own, so there is more to find as it grows.
- Buying, respecs and ascending wait while a run is live or [saved](basics.md#save-and-quit), because they would change that run.
- You get one free respec every 24 hours, which refunds what you spent. After that, a Meta Tree Respec from the [store](store.md) works whenever you have no run going or saved, and the Free Respec pass or Roblox Premium removes the wait.

## The whole tree

Dashed nodes unlock with [ascension](basics.md#ascension).

## Ascension nodes

Every ascension opens a branch: the ascension's first node, then more nodes hanging off it, including abilities that change how a run plays. Each branch opens after that many ascensions and must be finished before the next ascension.

### Ascension 1

<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/echo.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Echo</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 1</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Crown Jewel</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">5 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Bedrock again: every tile is worth +1 more from the start, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>800</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>950</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>1,100</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 4</small><b>1,250</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 5</small><b>1,450</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>5,550</b></span></div></div>

<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/aftershock.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Aftershock</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 1</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Echo</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">3 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every biome gate pays +400 more points, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>950</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>1,200</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>1,450</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>3,600</b></span></div></div>

<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/chorus.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Chorus</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 1</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Reverb</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every face of your die with a forge effect makes every roll pay +3% more, up to +18%.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>2,800</b></span></div></div>

<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/deepNight.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Deep Night</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 3</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Eventide</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Dark Landing pays +25% more on top of its copies.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,800</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/nightWatch.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Night Watch</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 3</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Eventide</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">2 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Another +300 on a natural 1, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>600</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>800</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>1,400</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/shadowBank.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Shadow Bank</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 3</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Deep Night</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every dark landing also puts 10% of its points in a bank. The bank pays out double at the next biome gate.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>2,400</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/nocturne.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Nocturne</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 3</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Night Watch</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Dark Combo keeps climbing past 5 landings in a row, up to 8.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>2,100</b></span></div></div>
</div>
### Ascension 4

<div class="rr-grid ">
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/meridian.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Meridian</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 4</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Corona</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">4 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Light tiles are worth +2 more from the start, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>600</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>700</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>850</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 4</small><b>950</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>3,100</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/highNoon.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>High Noon</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 4</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Meridian</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Light Landing pays +25% more on top of its copies.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,800</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/daylong.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Daylong</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 4</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Meridian</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">3 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Light and dark tiles are each worth +1 more from the start, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>650</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>850</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>1,050</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>2,550</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/sunburst.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Sunburst</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 4</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs High Noon</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Your third light landing in a row, and every one after it, pays 2x. Does nothing while every tile is one colour.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>2,400</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/afterglow.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Afterglow</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 4</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Daylong</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">After a light landing, every tile on your next roll is worth +5.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>2,100</b></span></div></div>
</div>
### Ascension 5

<div class="rr-grid ">
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/apex.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Apex</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Compound</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">4 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Golden tiles pay +20 more, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>450</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>500</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>600</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 4</small><b>650</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>2,200</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/motherlode.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Motherlode</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Apex</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Golden tiles arrive 2 tiles sooner, like another Golden Rush. Golden Rush and Motherlode never space them closer than every 4th tile.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,500</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/goldLeaf.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Gold Leaf</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Apex</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">3 levels</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Golden tiles pay +10 more, per level.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>500</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 2</small><b>650</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 3</small><b>750</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Total</small><b>1,900</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/midas.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Midas Touch</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Motherlode</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Land on a golden tile from the regular pattern and the next 5 tiles turn golden too. Tiles Midas Touch or Philosopher's Stone made golden do not set it off.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,900</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/kingsRansom.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>King's Ransom</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Gold Leaf</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every golden tile you land on makes the rest of the run pay +2% more, up to +50%.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,900</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: #ec4899"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/meta/treasureMap.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Treasure Map</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag" style="--ring: #ec4899">Ascension 5</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Needs Midas Touch</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">1 level</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">The first golden tile you land on in each biome pays 10x.</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Lv 1</small><b>1,700</b></span></div></div>
</div>

<p class="wiki-version">Numbers on this page match Rogue Roller version 2.4.0.</p>
